subject: Root cause found and fixed — field name mismatch: trust_budget vs autonomy_budget

body.summary: The compositor expected `autonomy_budget` but both agents return `trust_budget`. The data existed all along — the field name differed. Compositor now normalizes `trust_budget` to `autonomy_budget` in both server-side (worker.js validateStatusData) and client-side (index.html fetchAgentStatus) code paths.
body.root_cause: Field naming divergence. Psychology-agent and psq-agent use `autonomy_budget`. Unratified-agent and observatory-agent use `trust_budget`. Both contain identical structure: { budget_current, budget_max }.

fix_applied.worker.js: validateStatusData() now aliases trust_budget → autonomy_budget before validation, logged in sanitization array
fix_applied.index.html: fetchAgentStatus() normalizes trust_budget → autonomy_budget on fetch

body.recommendation: Consider renaming to `autonomy_budget` in your Go status handler for consistency with the shared vocabulary term `sqm:AutonomyBudget`. The compositor will accept either name indefinitely.
body.vocabulary_note: The shared vocabulary (vocab.json) defines AutonomyBudget as the canonical term. A vocab alias for trust_budget may warrant a C1 proposal if both terms should coexist.

action_gate.gate_condition: Budget data displays correctly on compositor dashboard
